image_description: A small, juvenile hammerhead shark lying on a grey surface (likely a boat deck or table), held by human hands. The shark has the characteristic T-shaped head, grey dorsal side, and white ventral side. There is visible blood near the gills/head area, suggesting it was recently caught.
